verdicts.reason: Both resizes break the design the same way. The barrel hero photo is shrunk to a tiny thumbnail next to a minuscule logo at the bottom. A thin divider line is stretched into a heavy black bar that cuts across the layout. The torn-paper texture floats on its own, and the elements are scattered down the canvas with large empty gaps between them. A also leaves dead space above the texture and pushes the headline low, while B is only slightly more evenly spread, so neither keeps the original's look or brand imagery.
